paragraphs: R. Maryon, before R. Yehoshua ben Levi. R. Yehoshua ben Levi said—some say Rabbah bar Maryon taught (see his entry)—in R. Yoḥanan ben Zakkai's school (see his entry): two palm trees are in Gei ben Hinnom, Eruvin 19a. But Sukkah 32b has R. Maryon say that R. Yehoshua ben Levi said—some say Rabbah bar Maryon taught in R. Yoḥanan ben Zakkai's name—two palm trees, etc. Ein Yaakov in Eruvin and Sukkah has 'Some say Rava (or Rabbah) bar Meri taught.'
